https://cdn.townweb.com/pelicanrapids.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/Sherin_Park_Map_Web.jpg (city's campground map with per-site amperage and rig length, linked from that page), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Tent sites $15 per tent. Paid in advance at City Hall or the drop box; no refunds.

fees.source: Wayback 2026-04-11 city page ('Electric sites are $20 per site. Non-electric site is $15 per tent') + Campground Rules ('Sites must be paid for in advance either at City Hall or in the drop box. No refunds will be given.')

values.note: Reservations open in mid-January for the current year (City Hall 218-863-7076); drop-in campers pay at the cash box and may be asked to change sites if theirs is reserved. 14-night limit in any 30 days.

booking.source: Wayback 2026-04-11 city page ('You can make reservations beginning in mid January for the current year'; 'Reservations are highly recommended and can be made by calling City Hall at 218-863-7076'; 'There is a 14-day maximum camping limit in any 30-day period') + Rules ('Drop in campers will be asked to change sites, if that site is reserved during their stay') + map ('call ... for reservations or pay at the cash box')

values.note: Open from the Minnesota fishing opener in May through Pelican Rapids Oktoberfest in mid-October.

season.source: Wayback 2026-04-11 city page ('Sherin Memorial Campground is open from MN Fishing Opener in May through Pelican Rapids Oktoberfest in mid October')

values.note: 10 electric RV sites and one tent site (11). Sites 1-7 take RVs up to 30 ft, sites 8-10 up to 42 ft; site 10 is a drive-through.

sites.source: Wayback 2026-04-11 city page ('10 electrical sites for RVs ... and one non-electrical tent site'; 'Site 10 (Drive-thru) - Elec only') + city map ('#1 = 30 amp, up 30' RV' ... '#8 = 50 amp, up 42' RV' ... '#10 = 50 amp, up 42' RV')

values.note: Electric only: 30 A at sites 1-5, 50 A at sites 6-10. Water fill and dump station on the grounds.

hookups.source: City map (per-site amps: '#1 = 30 amp' through '#5 =30 amp', '#6 = 50 amp' through '#10 = 50 amp') + Rules ('Electric only RV sites available for $20 per site (Water fill & dump station available)')

facilities.source: Wayback 2026-04-11 city page ('a water fill & a sewer dump station') + city map ('Potable Water', 'Dump Station', 'Bathhouse')

note: City of Pelican Rapids campground in Sherin Memorial Park on the Pelican River (221 E Mill Ave, behind the swimming pool), with paved paths, a covered pavilion, riverbank fishing and a suspension bridge to E.L. Peterson Park. --Claude
summary: City campground page (Wayback 2026-04-11; live page Cloudflare 403), site map and rules read: $20 electric/$15 tent, 10 electric RV sites (30 A 1-5, 50 A 6-10; 30-ft limit 1-7, 42-ft 8-10) + tent site, water fill + dump, phone reservations from mid-January, drop-ins allowed, 14-night limit, fishing opener-mid Oct. Not waterfront kept.
flags: AMPERAGE now known (curation_note 2026-11-12 said unknown): the city map gives 30 A at sites 1-5 and 50 A at sites 6-10; electric set to 50. The map image was uploaded 2023-08 and is still the one the 2026 page links.
RIG LENGTH: sites 1-7 'up 30' RV', 8-10 'up 42' RV' - a 23-ft rig fits every RV site.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: sites 5-7 (~46.5707,-96.0791) and tent site 11 sit north of the pool toward a bend of the Pelican River, but the river (~12-15 m wide here, creek class) lies ~35-45 m beyond them through a continuous tree belt; the 'River walk' is a path. No open ground to the water, so no creekside upgrade.
SEASON: both ends are moveable (fishing opener, Oktoberfest), so no fixed dates set.
LIVE PAGE UNREAD: pelicanrapids.com still answers Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' 403 to the headless browser; the 2026-04-11 Wayback capture was used (fresh, post-2025).
Phone 218-863-7076 (City Hall) and website confirmed. Google Maps 4.3 from 98 reviews ('Sherin Park and Campground', 289 E Mill St). Pin at the pool's north edge, ~60-90 m from the sites; no move.
Note cleaned: dropped the RV Life park_type remark (curator bookkeeping), the site/hookup counts, 'Tent $15; reservable (open mid-Jan)' and the season sentence (fields hold them).
